name: GPU-based Voxelization via Rasterization
definition: A method to generate volumetric density 3D textures by rasterizing triangle slices directly into a 3D texture using the OpenGL rasterization pipeline, leveraging user camera viewport to determine fragment calls.
summary: GPU-based Voxelization via Rasterization generates 3D textures by rasterizing triangle slices directly into a 3D texture using the standard OpenGL pipeline, enabling free navigation and dynamic resolution.
